'''2000 Denver Grand Slam Kyle Craft Kyle Craft s DS Denver Grand Slam deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Kyle Craft]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2000 Denver Grand Slam]]. The post is titled 'Kyle Craft's DS Denver Grand Slam deck' and the strategy says 'It did just fine in the grand slam.' (posted 3 April 2000); no record or placing is given.<ref name="dt-5054">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5054 Kyle Craft s DS Denver Grand Slam deck], DeckTech (Kyle "Jedi.02" Craft, 3 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5054/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5054/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018185641/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5054/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Craft]]
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Denver Grand Slam]]
* '''Finish:''' None
* '''Published:''' 3 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Kyle Craft s DS Denver Grand Slam deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 EOps Craft DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Go to space abuse OR for a big drain.  I persoanlly think this is a deck that involves alot of play skill.  If you can play it do so if you want.

== Original post ==

'''Kyle Craft s DS Denver Grand Slam deck'''
* '''Author:''' Kyle "Jedi.02" Craft
* '''Published:''' April 3, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Go to space abuse OR for a big drain.  I persoanlly think this is a deck that involves alot of play skill.  If you can play it do so if you want.

=== Strategy ===

If you can't convince the other DeckTech members that it has a shot of winning against a good variety of decks it probably isn't worth submitting.

Once again i read this.  It did just fine in the grand slam. so hmmmmm
